about.title: A furry carnival in Colombia's coffee region
about.body: Sunfest 2027 is Furry Colombia's next big gathering: days of festivity, fursuits and community among mountains, coffee and wax palms. Same team as Moonfest, new season.

showcase.title: Your warm corner of the coffee region
showcase.body: Hotel Mocawa Resort is sun, palm trees and turquoise water in the heart of Quindío. Here the warmth of our Colombian land comes back: pool days, mild evenings and carnaval color in every corner.
